findings.message: No beat reaches 6/10 in the first 10% of the experience (best is 2.5). Players decide early whether to keep going.
findings.suggestion: Open with a short, legible high-interest moment (a promise of the core fantasy, a striking reveal, or a quick win), then dip to teach.

findings.message: 0.0-11.9: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 2.6 for 11.9 units (low and flat: boredom and quit risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: The strongest moment (9.5, Cornered fight) happens at 58% of the experience; later beats never top it.
findings.suggestion: Move or build a climax into the last 30%, or reduce the early peak so the ending is the highest point.

findings.message: 14.7-23.0: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 8.3 for 8.3 units (high and flat: numbness and fatigue risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: 15.1-25.8: intensity stays at or above 8 for 10.8 units (25% of the run).
findings.suggestion: Break the plateau into two peaks with a short release between them, or vary the kind of intensity (spatial, cognitive, emotional).

findings.message: Peak at 19.0 (8.5, Chase continues) is not followed by a drop of 2.5+ within 5.2 units.
findings.suggestion: After a peak, give a release beat (safe room, loot, story, shop, short traversal) so the next peak lands harder.

findings.message: 27.5-37.9: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 4.3 for 10.4 units (flat: interest stops moving).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.
